title: removed_at returns a new array without one element
purpose: First, middle and last index, a one-element array becoming empty, a chain of removals, strings, nested arrays, bytes and a role array; the receiver keeps its elements, and removal is by position where `-` is by value.

provenance.expected_basis: spec 6.6 and #251: removed_at(index) is the receiver's elements except the one at index, in order.
